paragraphs.text: Renew the single downspout at the paved court. I would like the water kept away from the doorway, but have not chosen the final outlet arrangement.
A capped pipe is visible beside the downspout. Its destination and usability were not established. The old downspout discharged onto paving.
Neither connection into the capped pipe nor a surface discharge has been approved. Please confirm the pipe and agree the termination before finalizing that part of the scope.
Renew downspout, with termination allowance pending confirmation of drainage connection or surface discharge. No connection method is fixed in this draft.
